visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a professional grey suit, adorned with numerous strings of mala beads and a distinctive headband, stands behind a desk in a studio office. She holds a long staff and gestures animatedly towards two colleagues sitting across from her. The background is filled with religious charts and fortune-telling props under bright studio lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the woman shouting with wide eyes and expressive mouth movements, pointing her staff at a male colleague who looks dejected. The editing is fast-paced, using jump cuts to emphasize her anger and physical gestures within the cramped office space. (3) The woman points to a string of beads on her wrist, showcasing them to a female colleague who leans in to inspect the jewelry. The lighting remains flat and bright, focusing on the textures of the beads and the characters' exaggerated facial expressions. (4) A transition screen appears with swirling graphic patterns and bold Chinese text. Following this, the scene shifts to a modern corporate meeting room where four people sit around a table. A woman stands at the head of the table holding a document and looking frustrated. (5) The office lights dim significantly, and the woman at the head of the table begins a dramatic ritual. She holds a glowing golden orb and then a small ritual bell, swinging it vigorously while her colleagues look on with a mix of confusion and awe in the low-light environment.

Loud cartoonish thuds and impact SFX are heard synchronously with her shouting gestures, creating a comedic emphasis on her anger. (3) The voice becomes calmer and conversational as she discusses a specific item. The background music maintains a rhythmic, upbeat pace with a steady drum beat that complements the edited dialogue cuts. The female speaker adopts a rhythmic, sing-song intonation characteristic of a mock-ritual performance. (5) The chanting reaches a crescendo followed by a loud, climactic impact SFX and then a return to conversational speech.
